meta.title: Prairie Town hourly profiles (shapes from SPP, 2025)
meta.source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-930 Hourly Electric Grid Monitor, six-month BALANCE files, balancing authority SWPP (Southwest Power Pool), calendar year 2025
meta.license: EIA data are U.S. government works in the public domain; derived profiles CC BY 4.0
meta.normalisation: implausible demand hours (under half the median, or 3+ identical consecutive values) replaced by the day-ahead forecast rescaled to adjacent actual demand, and excluded from day picks; forecast examples from January-April only (from May SPP reports a forecast about 10% above demand, a reporting mismatch); demand and forecast / 2025 peak hourly demand; wind and solar / their own 2025 maximum hourly output; integers in thousandths; EIA adjusted values; hours ending, local time (Central); daylight-saving transition days excluded from day picks
